title: IE Ladies’ Day

sections.alt: Ladies’ Day banner — Southwest Bowls palm-tree logo with the words “Ladies’ Day” on a yellow background.

migrationNotes: This page carries no body text of its own — it is a banner image plus two buttons.
It has no form block; the sign-up form lives on /ie-sign-up.
The Results button points at /cl-ld1, the Inland Empire Ladies Day results, which is now migrated. It is also reachable at the clearer alias /ie-ladies-day-results.
